title: The War Horns
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Elder Brunna hears frost giant horns over the Rime every night and wants to know who they answer to.

About

Given byElder Brunna
Level24
LengthMedium
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Giant War Horn ×3

Steps

  1. Talk to Elder Brunna (inside Frostspire) to get the quest.
  2. Giant war horns (3) - Giant War Horn inside Frostspire

Rewards

Reward
Gold2,496
Character XP78,000
Quest points1

What Elder Brunna says

Elder Brunna: The same mark on all three. It's a name: Hrimgar. Every brute on the Rime carries his horn.

Elder Brunna: The thane needs to hear this. Go and tell him. I'll be along once I've had a closer look at these.
